notes.title: Update 1.1 - Flow Mode & Performance
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32072867/84c61c2d1ac3620ab3f5e9c43ff19b27ce7b61b1.png[/img]

[b]Flow mode just arrived![/b]

We want to introduce you to a new zen-like infinite episode called [b]flow mode[/b]. It's available for [b]FREE[/b] once you finish the game, and it's a little story about exploration and relaxation. With just a couple of small puzzles, you can wander around to enjoy the surroundings. You can touch things, sail, ice-skate, control sound FX, and much more.

We also fixed many bugs, including one that caused a high CPU usage in some cases. It should run smoother now ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32072867/0ea2c2fcd1af8f0c580f15005b80aaddccd0fee7.gif[/img]

Again, thank you for your feedback and your support, and please keep on sending us whatever you want to [b]hola@nada.studio[/b]

Sergio & Jacobo.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
We have fixed a small bug that, sometimes, caused the game to freeze when you pressed 'exit game'. Now it should be lightning fast!
We also fixed some minor bugs.

If you find anything wrong, or have any suggestion, please mail us :)
hola@nada.studio
